s1.title: Product Manager
s1.desc: I embed into your team and lead your product: roadmap, backlog, specs, coordination. Full-time or part-time, depending on your needs.
s1.for_who: Startups, SMBs and large companies that need a PM up and running quickly, without the constraints of a full recruitment process.
includes: I take ownership of the product vision and roadmap.
I manage the backlog, write specs and run sprints.
I coordinate tech, design and business teams.
I set up your agile rituals and management tools.
I adapt to your existing stack and processes.

s2.title: Process Automation
s2.desc: I automate your business processes to save you time: from simple tool connections to WhatsApp conversational agents, including CRM and ERP integrations.
s2.for_who: Teams losing time on manual, repetitive tasks: onboarding, reporting, follow-ups, data synchronisation.
includes: I map your processes and identify automation opportunities.
I deploy your workflows on N8N, Make or Zapier.
I connect your tools via API (CRM, ERP, databases…).
I build and connect WhatsApp agents to your business.
I handle monitoring and post-deployment maintenance.

s3.title: Product Builder
s3.desc: You have an idea and need a product. I guide you from design to development to build your showcase website, booking platform or custom internal tool.
s3.for_who: Entrepreneurs, hoteliers, restaurateurs and SMBs who want a professional online presence or a custom business tool, delivered fast.
includes: I scope the need and define the product architecture.
I design the user experience and visual identity.
I develop and deliver a fully functional turnkey product.
I train you on the tool so you're fully autonomous.

faq.title: What people ask me
faq.q1: How does a first project work?
faq.a1: We start with a free 30-minute call to understand your context and needs. If the project is a fit, I send you a proposal with the scope, timeline and pricing.
faq.a2: It varies depending on the nature and volume of the mission. I'll share my rates during our first call. I prefer long-term relationships over one-shot projects.
faq.q3: Do you work with already structured teams?
faq.a3: Yes, and that's actually where I add the most value. I know how to integrate into an existing environment, work with your devs, designers and ops, without friction.

experience.meta_desc: Arthur Souchon's career: API Product Owner at Numberly, product management, automation and digital product creation.
experience.title: My experience
experience.subtitle: Five experiences at the crossroads of product, tech and data.

j1.title: API Product Owner
j1.desc:
Numberly Martech Platform (SaaS CRM Automation) used by key account clients to manage and send their multichannel communication campaigns.

I manage the product backlog, write functional and technical specs, and take part in feature testing.

I automate internal processes via N8N with measurable productivity gains. I also led the development of the platform's API layer, as well as the creation from scratch of the API documentation website — from design to launch.

j2.title: Integration Project Manager
j2.desc:
Shippeo is a real-time transport visibility platform.

My mission: connecting the TMS (Transport Management Systems) of key accounts like Amazon with carriers' systems (GLS, DPD).

I automated two integration processes via Google Sheets, reducing manual interventions, and handled API monitoring to ensure data flow continuity.

j3.title: Product Owner
j3.desc:
Apprenticeship at Ekwateur, a green energy supplier.

I led the evolution of an automated client debt follow-up software: user needs analysis, task prioritisation on JIRA, and technical spec writing.

I coordinated between business teams and developers, owning the product vision across the full delivery cycle.

j4.title: Data Analyst
j4.desc:
Internship at Deloitte within a data team.

I conducted NLP analyses for semantic clustering of CVs, enabling better profile categorisation.

I also automated invoice statement processing in Python for audit engagements, and built visualisation dashboards with Tableau and PowerBI.

j5.title: Web Developer
j5.desc:
Internship in web development at a digital agency.

I developed Front-End interfaces in HTML, CSS and JavaScript for agency clients, while working on SEO optimisation and emailing strategies.

I also implemented web scraping with Python (BeautifulSoup) to collect and structure data for client projects.

realisations.meta_desc: Real projects: API documentation, WhatsApp channel, payment automation, portfolio. Problem, solution, impact.
realisations.title: Projects
realisations.subtitle: Real projects, from problem to result.

c1.title: API Documentation Website
c1.problem: No API documentation existed. Clients and partners had to contact internal teams to understand available endpoints, slowing down integrations and overwhelming support.
c1.solution: Built an API documentation website from scratch: information architecture, stack selection, spec writing, dev team coordination through to launch.
c1.impact: Full client autonomy on API integration. Reduced support tickets related to technical questions. Better platform adoption.

c2.title: WhatsApp, un nouveau canal de communication
c2.problem: Numberly clients sent campaigns only via email and SMS. The absence of WhatsApp represented a commercial shortfall and a limitation against market expectations.
c2.solution: Led the development of the WhatsApp channel on the Numberly Martech Platform: spec writing, WhatsApp Business API integration, testing coordination and production deployment.
c2.impact: New channel available to all clients. New commercial opportunities and better engagement across multichannel campaigns.

c3.title: Automated debt follow-up product
c3.problem: The debt follow-up process was manual, time-consuming and error-prone. No automatic prioritisation, no centralised tracking, teams working in silos.
c3.solution: Automated debt follow-up software. Operations teams could launch follow-up batches directly from the interface. Backlog management, technical spec writing and coordination between business teams and developers.
c3.impact: Full automation of the follow-up process, productivity gains for the debt recovery team.

c4.title: This portfolio
c4.problem: No professional online presence to showcase my profile, services and background in a clear and distinctive way.
c4.solution: Designed and built a portfolio from scratch with Nuxt 3, including an integrated AI assistant, dark/light mode, FR/EN multilingual support and deployment on Vercel.
c4.impact: Professional online presence, AI chatbot available 24/7 to answer visitor questions, deployed in 1 week.

univers.meta_desc: Beyond work: competitive padel, Dofus world champion 2023, football and event organisation.
univers.title: My universe
univers.subtitle: What I do on the side

padel.title: Padel - Competition
padel.desc1: I've been playing competitive padel since 2022. Ranked in the top 10% in France, I train every week and regularly compete in tournaments around Paris.
padel.desc2: Padel taught me that tactical thinking and real-time adaptation are often worth more than raw power. Lessons I apply directly in my daily life: reading the situation, adjusting strategy, staying calm under pressure.

esport.title: World Champion - Dofus
esport.desc1: I've always loved the Dofus universe, and I had the opportunity to compete in esport on this game for many years, winning the world championship title in 2023 with my team after several months of competition.
esport.desc2: Esport shaped me as much as my studies. Managing a high-level team, analysing complex game strategies, performing under pressure in world finals — these are skills directly transferable to the professional world. Mastering complex systems, a competitive mindset, rapid decision-making under pressure: this is my real school.

univers.quote: Competition taught me one essential thing: the difference between good and great is rarely talent — it's discipline, preparation, and the ability to stay lucid when the stakes are high.

evenement.title: Event Organisation
evenement.desc1: I've been organising private events for friends and family for several years: parties, tournaments, holidays. From logistics to communication and on-site coordination, I've learned to manage uncertainty and deliver a memorable experience despite the unexpected.
evenement.desc2: Running a successful event is exactly like running a project: anticipate, delegate, pivot fast. A school of operational discipline I apply every day in my work.

football.title: Football, a passion
football.desc1: Football has been part of my life since childhood. I play five-a-side regularly with friends, but where I enjoy it most is watching games with the crew — picking apart every missed chance while cheering on my beloved club, PSG.
football.desc2: This sport taught me the value of friendship. Nothing beats a Champions League night with the right people, passionately debating every refereeing decision or the perfect line-up. Football is, above all, an excuse to share moments that matter.
